useAIChat:
/**
 * Chat hook wrapping Vercel AI SDK useChat.
 * Adds auth gate, feature consent, and real-time cost tracking.
 *
 * @param authState - Auth state from useAIAuth
 * @param config - Chat configuration
 * @returns Chat state and actions
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * const authState = useAIAuth();
 * const { messages, append, stop, isLoading, cost } = useAIChat(authState, {
 *   provider: 'anthropic',
 *   model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
 * });
 * ```
 */
export declare function useAIChat(authState: AIAuthState, config?: UseAIChatConfig): UseAIChatReturn;
useAICost:
/**
 * Track cumulative AI cost across a conversation session.
 *
 * @param config - Cost configuration
 * @returns Cost tracking state and actions
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * const cost = useAICost({ markup: 4.0 });
 * // After each AI response:
 * cost.recordUsage({ promptTokens: 100, completionTokens: 50, totalTokens: 150 }, 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514');
 * // Display:
 * console.log(cost.formattedCost);       // "$0.0020"
 * console.log(cost.formattedBilledCost); // "$0.0080"
 * ```
 */
export declare function useAICost(config?: UseAICostConfig): UseAICostReturn;
AIChat:
/**
 * Drop-in AI chat component with configurable visibility.
 *
 * @example
 * ```tsx
 * // End-user facing - minimal UI
 * <AIChat systemPrompt="You are a helpful assistant." />
 *
 * // Admin facing - full stats
 * <AIChat showUsage showModel showCost showTimestamps />
 * ```
 */
export declare function AIChat({ systemPrompt, placeholder, config, showUsage, showModel, showCost, showTimestamps, showToolCalls, onMessage, onUsage, onError, className, }
calculateCost:
/**
 * Calculate cost from token usage for a given model.
 *
 * @param usage - Token usage (promptTokens, completionTokens)
 * @param model - Model ID (must exist in AI_TOKEN_PRICING)
 * @param markup - Markup multiplier (default: 4.0)
 * @returns Cost breakdown with provider and billed amounts
 * @throws Error if model is not in pricing table
 */
export declare function calculateCost(usage: AIUsage, model: string, markup?: number): AICostResult;
EMPTY_COST:
/** Empty cost result for initialization */
export declare const EMPTY_COST: AICostResult;
